title: ESQET Axiom 3: ℤ₃ Torsion Forces Three Fermion Generations
description: The vacuum manifold ℳ_vac contains a canonically embedded lens space L(3,1) = S³/ℤ₃ as a persistent 3-cycle. π₁(L(3,1)) = ℤ₃ classifies chiral zero modes. Anomaly cancellation (gauge + gravitational + discrete) forces exactly three generations of Standard Model fermions. N_generations = 3 is the unique integer solution to the ℤ₃³ discrete anomaly cancellation condition.
